scope: Only planning documents and docs/post-mvp/mockups; no application verification or release gate run.

checks.description: 19 primary views × 4 sizes × normal and warnings states, with 23 synthetic students.

interactions.observed: Two recent notes are visible only for the populated profile; Altre note opens the remaining labelled notes on demand; the header action is labelled Modifica.
Selecting a day opens P13 directly with no intermediate dialog; cards with different content remain aligned at the top.

Names stay in two columns from 430px through 320px. The duplicate uses an SVG warning and reads Sabato, Mercoledì. Full day names remain informational, name-only buttons assign to the current day, and the X is the explicit remove action.

Double-clicking Giulia increases Disponibili from 3 to 4 and leaves the original crew slot free. Crew headers show the real destination and separate crew number without the redundant word Destinazione.

Grey, green and blue boat states are simultaneously visible with a legend. Selecting Equipaggio 5 without a boat and then blue Quest 14 makes Quest 14 green and updates the crew summary. This mock mutation is in memory only.
Ordinamento appears above Alfabetico and Valutazione; both controls are 40 CSS px high and the overview has no horizontal overflow.
Course identity, scan counters, duty coverage, crew warnings, evaluation toggle, blank evaluation cells and P19 hierarchy remain operational in the isolated mock.

limitations: Measurements describe synthetic layouts and primary interactive states, not every production state.
No physical-device, 200% text, contrast certification or production accessibility claim.
P17 deliberately uses more vertical space to keep full names and five direct evaluation controls visible.
No persistence, OCR accuracy, voice latency or cross-session integrity verification.
P04 and P19 are approved and the visual structure of P15 is approved. Human review of the r6 refinements and interactions on P08, P13, P14, P15 and P18 is still required.
